name: justdoit
description: Just Do It - a full-stack todo app with categories

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @justdoit/contracts build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @justdoit/database build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @justdoit/backend build && pnpm --filter @justdoit/frontend build
